programme.title: Karm
programme.desc: Young lovers Arvind and Asha plan to marry, but when Asha's astrologer father predicts that her fiancée will die on their wedding day, the couple decide to sidestep fate and simply live together.

programme.title: Khote Sikkay
programme.desc: An unknown horseback rider is after Jhanga, an evil and troublesome gangster who has terrorised everybody in the village, because he is responsible for his father's death.

programme.title: Mili
programme.desc: Curmudgeonly Shekhar (Amitabh Bachchan) is new to the block, and it doesn't take long before the street noise, as well as the children playing nearby, push his tolerance to the limit. To the rescue comes Mili (Suresh Chatwal), who has the exact opposite disposition. While Shekhar may be at a loss over what to do with her at first, he eventually falls in love. Unfortunately, when the time comes to ask for her hand, he finds out Mili has a fatal medical condition and only has a few weeks to live.

programme.title: Haathi Mere Saathi
programme.desc: Raju becomes very attached to his four elephants after they save his life. His wife, however, fears for her child and tells him that he must choose between the animals and his family.

programme.title: Seeta Aur Geeta
programme.desc: Seeta (Hema Malini) is an unhappy heiress who is mistreated by her aunt, Kaushalya (Manorama), who holds the purse strings in the household even though her wealth comes from Seeta's late parents. Despondent, Seeta runs off to end her life, but is rescued and mistaken for her lost twin sister, Geeta (also Malini), who grew up poor and became a tough-minded street performer. The two switch places, surprising those around them by their drastically changed temperaments.
